x: In 1913 OSCAR HORWOOD became the seventh holder of the office, and, with CLEM ARNOLD, alternated and jointly held the position until 1921. These were, of course, very critical years for the Club, covering as they did the first World War period when activities all but ceased.
In 1915, at Esher, the third position was again ours with 21 seconds covering the four men who were E. MUSSELBROOK 13, C.
